package schema_test

// Generator of go-oracle.json: what the frozen Go build's schema.Validate says
// about broken Reports. The Go code is frozen, so this is kept as text. To
// regenerate at the freeze commit: copy it to internal/schema/zz_oracle_test.go,
// run go test -count=1 -run TestZZOracle ./internal/schema, delete the copy.
//
// Every case starts from a base document (the populated test mode Report, or
// the benchmark-pass golden report.json) and applies operations given as JSON
// Pointers, so the TypeScript test can build the same document.

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/santhosh-tekuri/jsonschema/v6"
	"golang.org/x/text/language"
	"golang.org/x/text/message"

	"github.com/invia-flights/jscript-bench/internal/resultset/resultsettest"
	"github.com/invia-flights/jscript-bench/internal/schema"
)

type oracleOp struct {
	Op    string `json:"op"` // "set" or "delete"
	Path  string `json:"path"`
	Value any    `json:"value,omitempty"`
}

type oracleLeaf struct {
	Instance string `json:"instance"`
	Keyword  string `json:"keyword"`
	Kind     string `json:"kind"`
	Message  string `json:"message"`
}

type oracleCase struct {
	Name     string       `json:"name"`
	Base     string       `json:"base"`
	Ops      []oracleOp   `json:"ops"`
	Problems []string     `json:"problems"`
	Leaves   []oracleLeaf `json:"leaves"`
}

type rawCase struct {
	Name string
	Doc  string
}

func set(path string, v any) oracleOp { return oracleOp{Op: "set", Path: path, Value: v} }
func del(path string) oracleOp      { return oracleOp{Op: "delete", Path: path} }

func apply(t *testing.T, doc any, op oracleOp) any {
	toks := strings.Split(op.Path, "/")[1:]
	for i, tok := range toks {
		toks[i] = strings.ReplaceAll(strings.ReplaceAll(tok, "~1", "/"), "~0", "~")
	}
	if len(toks) == 0 {
		return op.Value
	}
	parent := doc
	for _, tok := range toks[:len(toks)-1] {
		switch p := parent.(type) {
		case map[string]any:
			parent = p[tok]
		case []any:
			i, _ := strconv.Atoi(tok)
			parent = p[i]
		default:
			t.Fatalf("%s: no container at %s", op.Path, tok)
		}
	}
	last := toks[len(toks)-1]
	switch p := parent.(type) {
	case map[string]any:
		if op.Op == "delete" {
			delete(p, last)
		} else {
			p[last] = op.Value
		}
	case []any:
		i, _ := strconv.Atoi(last)
		p[i] = op.Value
	default:
		t.Fatalf("%s: no container", op.Path)
	}
	return doc
}

func leaves(e *jsonschema.ValidationError, out *[]oracleLeaf) {
	if len(e.Causes) == 0 {
		kw := strings.Join(e.ErrorKind.KeywordPath(), "/")
		*out = append(*out, oracleLeaf{
			Instance: "/" + strings.Join(e.InstanceLocation, "/"),
			Keyword:  kw,
			Kind:     fmt.Sprintf("%T", e.ErrorKind),
			Message:  e.ErrorKind.LocalizedString(message.NewPrinter(language.English)),
		})
		return
	}
	for _, c := range e.Causes {
		leaves(c, out)
	}
}

func TestZZOracle(t *testing.T) {
	populated, err := json.Marshal(resultsettest.Populated())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	bench, err := os.ReadFile("../writer/testdata/golden/benchmark-pass/report.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	bases := map[string][]byte{"populated": populated, "benchmark-pass": bench}

	long := strings.Repeat("x", 5000)
	cases := []struct {
		name, base string
		ops        []oracleOp
	}{
		{"valid populated", "populated", nil},
		{"valid benchmark", "benchmark-pass", nil},
		{"unknown status", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/checks/0/status", "weird")}},
		{"trust marker is wrong", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/findings/0/evidence/0/trust", "trusted")}},
		{"bad fingerprint", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/findings/0/fingerprint/value", "nope")}},
		{"test case without a suite", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/test_cases/0/suite", "")}},
		{"suite row without a suite", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/inventory/test_suites/0/suite", "")}},
		{"test file without a suite", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/inventory/test_files/0/suite", "")}},
		{"relative path base", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/findings/0/locations/0/path_base", "cwd")}},
		{"zero-based line", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/findings/0/locations/0/start/line", 0)}},
		{"empty re-run command", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/findings/0/reproduction/rerun_command", []any{})}},
		{"fraction over the maximum", "benchmark-pass", []oracleOp{set("/benchmark/areas/0/parts/0/score", 100.5)}},
		{"large number over the maximum", "benchmark-pass", []oracleOp{set("/benchmark/areas/0/parts/0/score", 123456)}},
		{"tiny negative number", "benchmark-pass", []oracleOp{set("/benchmark/areas/0/parts/0/score", -0.00001)}},
		{"huge number", "benchmark-pass", []oracleOp{set("/benchmark/areas/0/parts/0/score", 1e21)}},
		{"long text over the limit", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/findings/0/evidence/0/text", strings.Repeat("y", 12345))}},
		{"enum with null", "benchmark-pass", []oracleOp{set("/benchmark/status", "nope")}},
		{"wrong format id", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/format", "other")}},
		{"evidence over 4 KiB", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/findings/0/evidence/0/text", long)}},
		{"unknown top-level field", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/surprise", 1)}},
		{"unknown field in a finding", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/findings/0/surprise", true)}},
		{"two unknown fields", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/zz", 1), set("/aa", 2)}},
		{"one missing field", "populated", []oracleOp{del("/run/id")}},
		{"two missing fields", "populated", []oracleOp{del("/run/id"), del("/run/command")}},
		{"string for an integer", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/run/duration_ms", "90000")}},
		{"fraction for an integer", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/run/duration_ms", 1.5)}},
		{"negative integer", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/run/duration_ms", -1000000)}},
		{"large negative count", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/source/file_count", -1234567)}},
		{"null for a string", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/run/id", nil)}},
		{"array for an object", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/run", []any{})}},
		{"bool for an array", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/findings", true)}},
		{"enum with a wrong type", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/findings/0/severity", 3)}},
		{"date without T", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/run/started_at", "2026-10-25 10:15:00Z")}},
		{"date too short", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/run/started_at", "yesterday")}},
		{"month out of range", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/run/started_at", "2026-13-01T00:00:00Z")}},
		{"leap second at noon", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/run/started_at", "2026-10-25T12:00:60Z")}},
		{"leap second at midnight", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/run/started_at", "2026-12-31T23:59:60Z")}},
		{"bad offset", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/run/started_at", "2026-10-25T10:15:00+0100")}},
		{"lower case t and z", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/run/started_at", "2026-10-25t10:15:00.5z")}},
		{"day out of range", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/run/started_at", "2027-02-29T00:00:00Z")}},
		{"day 32", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/run/started_at", "2026-01-32T00:00:00Z")}},
		{"month not digits", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/run/started_at", "2026-1x-01T00:00:00Z")}},
		{"year not digits", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/run/started_at", "20x6-01-01T00:00:00Z")}},
		{"slashes in the date", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/run/started_at", "2026/01/01T00:00:00Z")}},
		{"hour out of range", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/run/started_at", "2026-01-01T25:00:00Z")}},
		{"fraction without digits", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/run/started_at", "2026-01-01T10:15:00.Z")}},
		{"minute not digits", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/run/started_at", "2026-01-01T10:1x:00Z")}},
		{"valid offset", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/run/started_at", "2026-01-01T10:15:00+01:00")}},
		{"leap second shifted by the offset", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/run/started_at", "2026-01-01T00:29:60+00:30")}},
		{"leap second wrong after the offset", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/run/started_at", "2026-01-01T00:30:60+00:30")}},
		{"offset out of range", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/run/started_at", "2026-01-01T00:30:00+24:00")}},
		{"wide digits", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/run/started_at", "２０２６-01-01T00:00:00Z")}},
		{"quote in a date", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/run/started_at", "2026-0\"-01T00:00:00Z")}},
		{"node variant unknown", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/contexts/1/node/variant", "windows")}},
		{"node is a string", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/contexts/1/node", "24")}},
		{"html in a field name", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/findings/0/<b>", 1)}},
		{"slash in a field name", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/run/a~1b", 1)}},
		{"test mode with areas", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/benchmark/areas", []any{})}},
		{"test mode with a verdict", "populated", []oracleOp{set("/benchmark/verdict", "pass")}},
		{"computed without fingerprint", "benchmark-pass", []oracleOp{del("/benchmark/fingerprint")}},
		{"computed without areas", "benchmark-pass", []oracleOp{del("/benchmark/areas")}},
		{"unknown field in a part", "benchmark-pass", []oracleOp{set("/benchmark/areas/0/parts/0/surprise", 1)}},
		{"unknown part state", "benchmark-pass", []oracleOp{set("/benchmark/areas/0/parts/0/state", "weird")}},
		{"part score over 100", "benchmark-pass", []oracleOp{set("/benchmark/areas/0/parts/0/score", 101)}},
		{"short hash not hex", "benchmark-pass", []oracleOp{set("/benchmark/fingerprint/hash", "zz")}},
		{"computed verdict null", "benchmark-pass", []oracleOp{set("/benchmark/verdict", nil)}},
		{"weight zero", "benchmark-pass", []oracleOp{set("/benchmark/areas/0/weight", 0)}},
		{"several problems", "populated", []oracleOp{
			set("/checks/0/status", "weird"), del("/run/id"), set("/findings/0/locations/0/start/line", 0), set("/surprise", 1)}},
	}

	var out []oracleCase
	for _, c := range cases {
		var doc any
		if err := json.Unmarshal(bases[c.base], &doc); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		for _, op := range c.ops {
			// Round-trip the value so numbers are float64 as in the base.
			b, _ := json.Marshal(op.Value)
			var v any
			_ = json.Unmarshal(b, &v)
			op.Value = v
			doc = apply(t, doc, op)
		}
		data, err := json.Marshal(doc)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		oc := oracleCase{Name: c.name, Base: c.base, Ops: c.ops, Problems: schema.Validate(data), Leaves: []oracleLeaf{}}
		if oc.Problems == nil {
			oc.Problems = []string{}
		}
		inst, _ := jsonschema.UnmarshalJSON(strings.NewReader(string(data)))
		if verr, ok := compiled().Validate(inst).(*jsonschema.ValidationError); ok {
			leaves(verr, &oc.Leaves)
		}
		out = append(out, oc)
	}

	var raws []map[string]any
	for _, r := range []rawCase{
		{"empty", ""},
		{"blank", "  \n"},
		{"truncated", `{"a": [1, 2`},
		{"bad token", `{"a": tru}`},
		{"trailing value", `{} {}`},
		{"trailing garbage", `{} x`},
		{"not an object", `[]`},
	} {
		p := schema.Validate([]byte(r.Doc))
		raws = append(raws, map[string]any{"name": r.Name, "doc": r.Doc, "problems": p})
	}

	report, err := json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{
		"recordedFrom": "238e07f66d8cafab24ef363cb79e207bd48babd8",
		"bases":        map[string]string{"populated": string(populated)},
		"cases":        out,
		"raw":          raws,
	}, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile("testdata/go-oracle.json", append(report, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

// compiled compiles the schema again: the package keeps its compiled schema
// private.
func compiled() *jsonschema.Schema {
	doc, _ := jsonschema.UnmarshalJSON(strings.NewReader(string(schema.Report())))
	c := jsonschema.NewCompiler()
	c.DefaultDraft(jsonschema.Draft2020)
	c.AssertFormat()
	_ = c.AddResource("report.schema.json", doc)
	return c.MustCompile("report.schema.json")
}
